NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以GPU与CUDA软件栈为核心，打造数据中心级全栈AI基础设施平台，赋能各行业AI应用。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Builds data-center-scale full-stack AI infrastructure on GPUs and CUDA to power AI across all industries.
concrete_bets: full-stack hardware, software, models and services platform

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 在全技术栈负责任地普及AI，以智能云平台和Microsoft 365 Copilot与智能体驱动企业生产力变革。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Broadly and responsibly democratize AI across the full stack, leading the AI platform wave with Copilot and agents.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge AI platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP将大语言模型与现有平台及本体整合，把AI带入企业和政府的每个决策环节。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Bring AI to every decision via AIP integrating LLMs with existing platforms and the Ontology.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Meta AI助手和AI眼镜为核心，将AI贯穿全系应用与下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embedding Meta AI across apps and AI glasses as the core of its next computing platform.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps, web, and AI glasses
Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses
AI-driven content ranking and discovery engine

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦推理模型训练、文本分类架构、循环Transformer、水印采样与小词表降本等模型技术。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers reasoning-model training, text-classification architectures, looped transformers, watermark sampling, and vocabulary-shrinking for inference cost.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及Agent Skills捐赠、Kimi K3.1模型、数据库RL奖励训练智能体与决策API等智能体工具。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Agent Skills donation, Kimi K3.1 model, RL-reward trained DB agents, and a fast Decisions API for apps.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI存储扩展、训练环境安全、NASK合作、Uber与AT&T企业部署及分发合规标准。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI storage scaling, training-environment security, NASK partnership, Uber/AT&T deployments, and distribution-partner safeguarding standards.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 文献挖掘、时间序列预测、关系数据建模、语音识别及结核、母婴超声、地球科学等垂直应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Literature mining, time-series forecasting, relational data, speech, TB screening, maternal ultrasound, and Earth-science geospatial agents.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: AWS Trainium可用性查询、TorchNeuron性能剖析与CUDA到MLX内核知识迁移等推理部署效率议题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Trainium availability lookup, TorchNeuron profiling, and translating CUDA kernel expertise to Apple MLX for deployment efficiency.
